summary: Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of Series LIII Additional Notes in the Argentine local capital markets. The notes total USD 40.4 million, bear a 6.25% coupon, and mature April 30, 2030, issued at 102.88% of face value including accrued interest. They are fungible with original Series LIII notes from April 30, 2026. This is a routine debt issuance with no special-situation features. No merger, tender, activist, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; simply monitor the issuer's ongoing debt obligations.
